note.zh: 片段可直接粘贴进库部件脚本；标「沙盒可运行」的能在本站沙盒里看到效果，其余需要 Archicad 环境。
note.en: Snippets can be pasted into a library part script. Those marked "runs in sandbox" work in the site sandbox; the rest need Archicad.

title.zh: 四腿桌：桌面 + 双层循环

desc.zh: 用两层 FOR 摆四条腿，位置按桌面尺寸算，改 w/d 腿自动跟随。每轮结束 DEL 1 清掉 ADD。
desc.en: Two nested FOR loops place four legs from the top size; change w/d and the legs follow. DEL 1 clears each ADD.

snippets.code:
w = 1.2
d = 0.6
h = 0.72
th = 0.04
legR = 0.03

ADD 0, 0, h - th
BLOCK w, d, th
DEL 1

FOR i = 1 TO 2
  FOR j = 1 TO 2
    ADD legR + (i - 1) * (w - 2 * legR), legR + (j - 1) * (d - 2 * legR), 0
    CYLIND h - th, legR
    DEL 1
  NEXT j
NEXT i

title.zh: 圆形阵列：ROTZ 每轮转一点

desc.zh: 把「旋转 → 平移 → 建模」放进循环，每轮转 360/n 度。DEL 2 同时清掉旋转和平移，避免累积。
desc.en: Put rotate → move → model inside the loop, turning 360/n each pass. DEL 2 clears both transforms so nothing accumulates.

snippets.code:
n = 12
r = 1.5

FOR i = 1 TO n
  ROTZ i * 360 / n
  ADD r, 0, 0
  BLOCK 0.2, 0.1, 0.6
  DEL 2
NEXT i

title.zh: 等距立柱：按长度自动分格

desc.zh: 间距由总长和根数算出，改 len 或 n 都能均分。位置用绝对坐标算，不靠累加。
desc.en: Spacing is derived from length and count, so changing len or n keeps it even; positions are absolute, not accumulated.

snippets.code:
len = 3.6
n = 7
gap = len / (n - 1)

FOR i = 1 TO n
  ADD (i - 1) * gap, 0, 0
  CYLIND 1.1, 0.03
  DEL 2
NEXT i

ADD 0, 0, 1.1
BLOCK len, 0.06, 0.04
DEL 1

desc.zh: 沙盒没有布尔运算，用左右两条 + 上下两块拼出圆孔；Archicad 里可换成 SUBGROUP 挖洞。
desc.en: Without booleans, split the panel into two side strips and two filler blocks; replace with SUBGROUP in Archicad.

snippets.code:
w = 0.60
h = 2.00
th = 0.02
holeX = 0.30
holeZ = 1.20
holeR = 0.06

BLOCK holeX - holeR, th, h

ADD holeX + holeR, 0, 0
BLOCK w - holeX - holeR, th, h
DEL 1

ADD holeX - holeR, 0, 0
BLOCK 2 * holeR, th, holeZ - holeR

ADD 0, 0, holeZ + holeR
BLOCK 2 * holeR, th, h - holeZ - holeR
DEL 2

title.zh: 参数夹紧：把输入限制在合理区间
title.en: Clamp parameters to a valid range

desc.zh: 写在参数脚本里，用户输错值会被自动拉回边界，同时保证高度不小于宽度的两倍。
desc.en: Put it in the parameter script: out-of-range input is pulled back, and height stays at least twice the width.

snippets.code:
! 参数脚本 / parameter script
IF b < 0.4 THEN b = 0.4
IF b > 1.2 THEN b = 1.2
IF h < b * 2 THEN h = b * 2

desc.zh: 把材质索引做成参数，用户选材质即可整件切换；`MATERIAL` 只影响其后的建模命令。
desc.en: Expose material indices as parameters; `MATERIAL` affects only the commands that follow it.

snippets.code:
! matFrame、matLeaf 为整数型材质参数
MATERIAL matFrame
BLOCK 0.05, 0.20, 2.10

MATERIAL matLeaf
ADD 0.05, 0, 0
BLOCK 0.90, 0.04, 2.00
DEL 1

title.en: Draw only on the home storey

desc.zh: `GLOB_CH_STORY_DIST` 不为 0 说明当前平面不是对象所在层，跳过重负载绘制，平面图更轻。
desc.en: A non-zero `GLOB_CH_STORY_DIST` means the plan is on another storey; skip heavy drawing to keep plans light.

snippets.code:
IF GLOB_CH_STORY_DIST = 0 THEN
  ! 本层：画完整细节 / home storey: full detail
  BLOCK 1.0, 0.6, 2.0
ELSE
  ! 他层：只画占位轮廓 / other storeys: outline only
  RECT2 0, 0, 1.0, 0.6
ENDIF

title.zh: 平面符号：轮廓 + 对角线 + 标注

desc.zh: 2D 脚本的最小骨架：矩形轮廓、一条对角线表示方向、一个中心圆点、一行文字。
desc.en: The minimal 2D skeleton: rectangle, a diagonal for orientation, a centre dot and one line of text.

desc.zh: `GLOB_SCALE` 是比例分母，1:50 得 50。乘上它，文字在图纸上保持固定字高。
desc.en: `GLOB_SCALE` is the denominator (1:50 gives 50); multiplying keeps text a constant size on paper.

title.zh: 读 CSV 到动态数组
title.en: Read a CSV into dynamic arrays

desc.zh: 先判 `OPEN` 返回值，再循环 `INPUT` 到 -1，行数用循环变量累加，最后 `CLOSE`。
desc.en: Check the `OPEN` return, loop `INPUT` until -1, count rows as you go, then `CLOSE`.

snippets.code:
DIM codeArr[]
DIM wArr[]

ch = OPEN ("TEXT", "sizes.csv", "SEPARATOR = ',', mode = ro, LIBRARY")
n = 0
IF ch > 0 THEN
  WHILE INPUT (ch, n + 1, 1, code, cw) > 0
    n = n + 1
    codeArr[n] = code
    wArr[n] = cw
  ENDWHILE
  CLOSE ch
ENDIF

title.en: Write a CSV line by line

desc.zh: `mode = wo` 覆盖写；`recordID` 换个值就换行。写完立刻 `CLOSE` 刷盘。
desc.en: `mode = wo` overwrites; changing `recordID` starts a new line. `CLOSE` immediately to flush.

snippets.code:
ch = OPEN ("TEXT", "out.csv", "SEPARATOR = ',', mode = wo, LIBRARY")
IF ch > 0 THEN
  OUTPUT ch, 1, 1, "CODE", "WIDTH"
  FOR i = 1 TO VARDIM1 (codeArr)
    OUTPUT ch, i + 1, 1, codeArr[i], STR (wArr[i], 8, 3)
  NEXT i
  CLOSE ch
ENDIF

title.en: Join an array into one label

desc.zh: 用 `+` 拼字符串，结尾去掉多余的分隔符，适合给 2D 标注生成汇总文字。
desc.en: Build the string with `+` and trim the trailing separator — handy for a summary 2D label.

snippets.code:
s = ""
FOR i = 1 TO n
  IF i > 1 THEN s = s + ", "
  s = s + codeArr[i]
NEXT i
TEXT2 0, 0, s
